test_title: PYST 47: SSC MTS 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A sum of Rs. 3000 becomes Rs. 4320 in 2 years at a certain rate of compound interest (compounding annually). How much this sum will become after 4 years?
solution:
Given:

Amount = Rs. 4320

Principal = Rs. 3000

Time = 2 years

Concept:

A = P × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

Calculation:

Let, rate = r.

According to the question,

⇒ 4320 = 3000 × (1 + r/100)²

⇒ (4320/3000) = (1 + r/100)²

⇒ (144/100) = (1 + r/100)²

⇒ 1 + r/100 = 12/10

⇒ r = 2/10 × 100 = 20%

After 2 more years, 4320 will become:

⇒ A = 4320 × (1 + 20/100)2

⇒ A = 4320 × (6/5)²

⇒ A = 6220.8

∴ In 4 years Rs. 3000 will amount to Rs. 6220.8 at 20% p.a. compound interest.
